description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificate of Exemption under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act No. 20 of 2009 Prime Land Recidencies and Seven Others
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice issued under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). It involves the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka exercising its statutory powers to issue certificates of exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution. The content focuses on regulatory compliance and legal authorization rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, land matters, commercial registrations, or other specialized categories.
